en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from one of his companions, from Musna Al Hannat and Al Hassan Al Sayqal who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Fasting one immersing himself into the water. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, and neither can the one in Ihraam’. 
He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Fasting one wearing the dripping wet clothes. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 6. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from certain persons of our people from Muthanna’ al-Hannat and al- Hassan al-Sayqal who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who is fasting and immerses himself in water. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, he must not do so and also one who is in the state of Ihram.’
He (the narrator) has said that he asked him (the Imam) about one who is fasting, puts on wet clothes. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, he must not do so.’”
